scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary
other_conditions: Worker must be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
Worker must hold a valid labour card issued by MBOCWWB
Worker must be residing in a relief camp due to the violence
Eligibility limited to families affected by the 03.05.2023 Tribal Solidarity March
Worker must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Student must be enrolled in Higher Secondary or equivalent, B.A./B.Sc/B.Com/Diploma, Post Graduate Degree/Diploma, Engineering or Medical Degree
benefits_summary: One-time assistance per child ranging from ₹5,000 for higher secondary up to ₹37,500 for engineering or medical degree courses.
